curriculum: The English full-time Maastricht bachelor is illustrated using the 2025–26 rules. Year 1 has twelve 4 EC courses and two 6 EC projects. Year 2 has eleven 4 EC core courses, one 4 EC elective and two 6 EC projects. Year 3 has six 4 EC electives, one 6 EC project, three 4 EC core courses and an 18 EC thesis. The groups total 60 EC each, with semester projects counted once. The Year 2 elective follows Appendix 1 order: Introduction to Image and Video Processing precedes Game Theory in the regulations, while the catalogue order differs. The standard route includes the Year 3 project and open electives under Appendix 1, with three per period and the 15 EC maximum per period. Repeat or equivalent electives should not add duplicate credit. Exchange, honours and educational minor routes are alternatives.
progression: Project 1-2 requires two of Discrete Mathematics, Calculus, Procedural Programming and Objects in Programming. Project 2-1 requires Project 1-1 and two of Procedural Programming, Objects in Programming and Data Structures & Algorithms. Project 2-2 additionally requires Project 1-2. Both Year 2 projects require registration for or completion of at least three programme courses in the respective semester. Project 3-1 requires Project 2-1 and registration for or completion of three Year 3 semester-one courses. Year 2 exams require 45 first-year EC. Year 3 exams require 60 first-year and 40 second-year EC. The thesis requires those credits and at least 138 overall. With 150 EC by the start of the last semester, the example can meet these gates on time. Project meetings and skills participation are part of the projects. The current programme page corroborates the broad elective and year progression structure. No current component-level regulatory claim is made.
components: Introduction to Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (KEN1110, year 1 core course)
Objects in Programming (KEN1220, year 1 core course)
Data Structures and Algorithms (KEN1420, year 1 core course)
Principles of Data Science (KEN1435, year 1 core course)
Computational and Cognitive Neuroscience (KEN1210, year 1 core course)
Probability and Statistics (KEN2130, year 2 core course)
Simulation and Statistical Analysis (KEN2530, year 2 core course)
Human Computer Interaction & Affective Computing (KEN2410, year 2 core course)
Natural Language Processing (KEN2570, year 2 core course)
Philosophy & Artificial Intelligence (KEN2120, year 2 core course)
Introduction to Image and Video Processing (Year 2 elective)
Project 3-1 (KEN3300, year 3 semester 1 project for external customers)
The 18 EC thesis requires 138 EC overall, including 60 EC in Year 1 and at least 40 EC in Year 2.
